credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of Geoffrey Rockefeller in a light colored shirt and mesh hat with sunglasses hanging from his mouth, head turned to the right.  This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Untitled (Godfrey Rockefeller?)
